content:
Lena (AE): Heads-up: FinServe wants a clear capacity+cost brief for their enterprise commit. Key asks: throughput sizing for 30-min morning spike, reserved GPUs vs burst credits, and KV-cache preheat play. Deadline EOD.
Ravi (SE): Quick numbers please: peak qps=800, avg tokens/turn=180. Target p99 < 400ms. They prefer hosted + customer-managed KMS.
Iris (Infra): Throughput calc (redwood-13b-quant): ~140 qps/GPU @avg_seq=180 (with batching). So peak needs ~6 GPUs (800/140=5.7) plus headroom for cold starts -> recommend min_reserved=6, burst_pool=3.
Nate (Pricing): Cost example (simplified): reserved monthly per-GPU = $2,400; burst GPU premium = +30% per-hour; token charge baseline $0.00025 per 1k tokens. Example peak 800 qps -> ~8.64M tokens/min. Token cost ~8.64M/1k*0.00025 = $2,160/min. With KV cache 60% hit -> $864/min.
Ravi (SE): Preheat plan: 20-30 minute KV seeding before window using synthetic calls to top prefixes. That reduces p99 significantly. We'll run a staging smoke test to prove <400ms.
Lena (AE): Customer asks for a worked monthly bill for two options: A) reserve 6 GPUs + burst as needed; B) reserve 8 GPUs and smaller burst. Nate, can you mock both?
Nate (Pricing): I'll create a 1-sheet with monthly math and include preheat/setup fee and a contingency buffer for SSO integration. ETA 24h.
ci-bot: Staging smoke test scheduled 2024-08-01T16:00Z, logs to /ci/finserve/poc.
Iris (Infra): Note: if they choose Private deployment, per-GPU throughput varies; we'll add disclaimer to the brief.
Lena (AE): Great. Action items: Nate -> pricing sheet, Ravi -> perf sim + smoke artifacts, Iris -> reserve staging GPUs and burst pool, Lena -> send questionnaire responses.
Nate (Pricing): On it.
Lena (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
